name: pnp-powerplatform-samples-colour-canvas-game
title: Colour Canvas Game
shortDescription: A Power Apps game that challenges players to memorise a colour and recreate it from memory as accurately as possible.
longDescription: Colour Canvas Game is a Power Apps Canvas App that tests a player's ability to remember and recreate colours from memory.
Players are briefly shown a randomly generated colour before attempting to recreate it using colour selection controls.
The solution demonstrates Power Apps game mechanics, timers, variables, collections, colour calculations, and custom scoring logic implemented using Power Fx.
